title: 121 ft Moonen Superyacht, FAMILYBILT, Available in Ft. Lauderdale

html:
Ft. Lauderdale, FL – 05/22/2024 – FYI Yachts is thrilled to announce the exclusive listing of FAMILYBILT, a stunning 121-foot superyacht now available for a discerning new owner in Ft. Lauderdale. Built by Moonen Yachts in the Netherlands and delivered in 2015, this exceptional vessel combines elegance and performance, designed by Dixon Yacht Design and recently refitted in 2022.

FAMILYBILT is the only Royal Denship 120 model, boasting an impressive LOA of 36.9 meters, a beam of 7.3 meters, a draft of 2 meters, and a volume of 268 GT. She offers an unparalleled experience for entertaining and relaxation with five-star luxury.

This superyacht accommodates up to 10 guests in five lavish staterooms, including a beautifully appointed on-deck master stateroom with an en-suite bath, a full-beam VIP stateroom, a double-bed stateroom, and two twin staterooms, each equipped with a Pullman berth.

FAMILYBILT’s naval architecture was masterfully developed by Stolk Marimecs. Constructed with a teak deck, GRP hull, and GRP superstructure, she achieves a top speed of 22 knots and a cruising speed of 16 knots. She is powered by two MTU diesel engines with a maximum cruising range of 2,200 nautical miles at 11 knots.

The yacht features an expansive aft deck with seating, a bar on the main deck, and a luxurious sky lounge, creating ideal settings for socializing and relaxation. An impressive swimming platform caters to water sports enthusiasts, while her sleek lines and powerful performance appeal to yachting connoisseurs.

FAMILYBILT ranks in the top 30% by LOA globally and is among 1,147 motor yachts in the 35-40m size range. Her top speed is 0.14 knots above the average, and her volume is 0.74 GT above the average for similar-sized yachts. She is listed at number 2,975 in the world rankings for the largest yachts and is the fifth-largest yacht built by Moonen Yachts.
